sentences.text: Kamalesh Pramanick & Anr vs Unknown on 13 February, 2024

Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 13.02.2024 Item No.121 CHC Allowed C.R.M.(A) 5726 of 2023 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Barasat Police Station Case No. 719/23 dated 07.10.2023 under Sections 498A/406/313 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
And In the matter of : Kamalesh Pramanick & anr.
...... petitioners Mr. Anirban Mitra, Mr. Amit Halder, Mr. Amit Roy, Ms. Madhumita Sadhukhan ....for the petitioners Mr. Bidyut Kumar Ray, Mr. Sujan Chatterjee ....for the State Petitioners pray for anticipatory bail.
Petitioners before us are the in-laws of the de facto complainant.
Husband applied for anticipatory bail and was granted such facility by the learned District Judge.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioner no.1, namely, Kamalesh Pramanick will report before the Investigating Officer once in a month till the conclusion of investigation and petitioner no.2, namely, Tulshi Pramanick @ Tusi Pramanick will cooperate with the investigation and on condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed. CRM(A) 5726 of 2023 is disposed of.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
